name: Taizhou Museum
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage See listing (hours, free entry); open prefecture museum, an hour's visit.

name: Taizhou Ocean World
reason: Wikivoyage See listing plus travelchinaguide 'Sea World'; permanent aquarium, multi-hour visit, paid.

name: Taizhou Fonte Wild Mainland
reason: Wikivoyage See listing; permanent theme park open daily (rule 2, 4).

name: Taizhou Fangte Water Park
reason: Rule 3: a sub-venue of the Fonte resort, seasonal summer water park, no source found in a fresh search. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Luqiao Leyuan
reason: Rule 1: OSM only; fresh English/Chinese search found no visitor source. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Taizhou Bay Wildlife Park
reason: Rule 1: OSM only, no visitor source found in fresh search. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Taizhou Confucian Temple
reason: Expedia lists 'Linhai the Confucius Temple', a blog and Wikivoyage photo caption name it; no counted See listing.

name: Sacred Heart Cathedral, Jiaojiang
reason: Rule 2: church; 2nd search found only Wikipedia (reopened 1987), nothing a visitor goes in to see.

name: Jiufeng Mountain
reason: Wikivoyage Do names the Huangyan climb: stone steps, temples, a vegetarian temple restaurant and views; half-day hike.

name: China Citrus Expo Park
reason: 2nd search: China Daily Taizhou feature 'A fruitful adventure awaits you in Taizhou' (2023) and Ctrip list the Huangyan expo park (180 citrus varieties, sculpture, picking, open all year); orange festival is only one season.

name: China Citrus Museum
reason: Rule 3: sits inside the citrus expo park (Ctrip address is the museum on the Huangyan-Qian road); part of the larger spot.

name: Huangyan Museum
reason: Rule 1: OSM only; local district museum no guide names. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Taizhou Central Hill Park
reason: Rule 1/3: ordinary urban park, no visitor source. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Taizhou Bay Wetland Park
reason: Rule 1: OSM only, no visitor source found. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Linghu Park
reason: Wikivoyage Do names Linghu and East Lake as the two large parks for a lake walk and boating; one source, city park.

name: Guohua Abacus Museum
reason: Rule 1/3: niche museum; 2nd search found only Expedia-style listings (supporting only), no tourism-board or guide source.

name: Wenling Changyu Dongtian
reason: Wikivoyage See plus travelchinaguide: 4A quarry-cave scenic area with Asia's only rock cave concert hall and stone museum.

name: Fangshan Global Geopark
reason: travelchinaguide names Fangshan-Nansong Mountain Scenic Area (Fangshan, Lion Peak, Longjiangmen) linked to Yandang; kept as the single Fangshan-Nansong entry.

name: Nansong Rock Scenic Area
reason: Rule 3: part of the Fangshan-Nansong scenic area, kept as one spot under Fangshan.

name: Qiongtai Xian Valley
reason: Qiongtai Xiangu is a Tiantai Mountain sight on the Chinese Wikipedia list; no counted visitor source found in a quick search.

name: Kuocang Mountain
reason: Range in Linhai/Xianju with wind farm and Shenxianju linkage; no counted source found, widely known to hikers and drivers.

name: Dachen Islands
reason: Wikivoyage, two China Daily Zhejiang pages and travelchinaguide name it: islands 52 km off Taizhou with marine landforms, sea-god temple and Red-tourism sites.

name: Yijiangshan Island
reason: Wikivoyage-level mention only; site of the 1955 battle with memorial; no counted visitor source found and access (military island) unverified.

name: Yijiangshan Island Battle Memorial Museum
reason: Rule 1: 2nd search found no visitor source; a Trip review says the Jiaojiang museum has a Yijiangshan section, so this is probably part of Jiaojiang museum or the island entry; coordinates are mainland.

name: Dongji Islands
reason: China Daily Zhejiang (2020 and 2021 islands features) names Dongji: 50+ islets, sunrise and cobble beach in Linhai.

name: Tiantai Mountain
reason: Wikivoyage See and travelchinaguide: national 5A box-syncline mountain scenic area, giving Taizhou its name. Wikivoyage geo (30.13,120.65) is wrong; the 29.271,121.054 point is plausible.

name: Guoqing Temple
reason: Wikivoyage lists it twice; birthplace of Tiantai Buddhism, 1,400-year-old working temple with free entry.

name: Fangguang Temple
reason: Wikivoyage lists it as a national key temple on Mount Tiantai; one source, no description of what to see.

name: Gaoming Temple
reason: Wikivoyage listing with no description; Wikipedia lists it; nothing says what to see.

name: Zhizhe Pagoda
reason: Rule 3: pagoda courtyard beside Guoqing Temple, part of the larger spot.

name: Tiantai Museum
reason: Rule 1: OSM only, local county museum. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Huading Mountain
reason: Highest peak of the Tiantai range and part of the scenic area; Wikivoyage mentions it only for the cuckoo azalea festival.

name: Xianju National Park
reason: Wikivoyage See (Shenxianju scenic area) and travelchinaguide: 5A area of rock pillars, waterfalls and the glass Ruyi bridge.

name: Ruyi Bridge
reason: Rule 3: Wikivoyage places it inside Shenxianju park; part of the larger spot.

name: Taoqi Ancient City
reason: China Daily Zhejiang 'Taozhu Scenic Spot' page and travelchinaguide name Taozhu Ancient City (best-preserved Ming anti-pirate guard city) in Linhai geopark; two counted sources. Real name Taozhu.

name: Linhai Ancient City Wall
reason: 2 counted sources, 2352 page views

name: East Lake, Linhai
reason: Wikivoyage prices East Lake in the Fucheng zone ticket with boats and walking; also a China Daily mention of the ancient-city zone.

name: Linhai Museum
reason: Wikivoyage See listing, free, closed Mondays; one source, local city museum.

name: Linhai Lu Xun Exhibition Hall
reason: Rule 1/3: OSM only; small memorial hall. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Wang Guanlan Former Residence
reason: Rule 2: former residence mostly seen from outside, no source. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Ruirong Feeling Tower
reason: Rule 1: no visitor source; coordinates (28.6414,121.2783) are in Huangyan though the note says Linhai: unreliable. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Kanmen Tidal Inspection Station
reason: Rule 2: heritage relic seen from outside, no visit possible beyond a glance.

name: Pu'an Lighthouse
reason: Wikivoyage names the lighthouse; one source; it sits at Dongsha village (300 m from it).

name: Yuhuan Island
reason: Rule 3: a whole island/county-level area, not a place; its draws are listed separately.

name: Dalu Island
reason: Wikivoyage, China Daily and travelchinaguide name it: 4A forested island with rock sculpture landscapes, ferry from Kanmen.

name: Jishan Island
reason: Wikivoyage lists this 3A island for seafood and scenery; no second counted source found.

name: Xuanmen Bay National Wetland Park
reason: Wikivoyage: black-headed gull and black-faced spoonbill wintering habitat; one source.

name: Yuhuan Xuanmen Bay Sightseeing Agricultural Park
reason: Wikivoyage names it a 4A park, one of east China's largest sightseeing farms, ticket 35 yuan; one source.

name: Xuanmen Bay Water Park
reason: Rule 1/3: generic summer water park, dead Wikivoyage link, closed winter.

name: Yuhuan Park
reason: Rule 3: ordinary city park. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Longxi Animation Flower Valley
reason: Wikivoyage lists this 3A kids' flower valley and dinosaur park; one source.

name: Dongsha Fishing Village
reason: Wikivoyage: preserved fishing village at Kanmen, 3A, provincial historic village with seafood and Pu'an lighthouse.

name: Baima Ao Beach
reason: Wikivoyage names the 3A sandy beach at Ganjiang; second-tier beach.

name: Paotai Beach
reason: Rule 3: OSM name 700 m from Baima Ao, no source; likely same area. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Sanmen Bay
reason: Rule 3: a large bay, no place to visit; only the crab festival links to it. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Lishimen Reservoir
reason: Rule 1: reservoir with no visitor source found. Fresh English and Chinese search (2nd pass) found no visitor source.

name: Shitang Peninsula (Shitang Fishing Village)
reason: China Daily 'Enchanting islands in Taizhou' and travelchinaguide ('Shitang Fishing Village') name the Wenling stone-house village with murals and sea views; homestays. Sources: https://regional.chinadaily.com.cn/ezhejiang/etaizhou/2020-03/12/c_461873.htm; travelchinaguide Taizhou

name: Sansuan Island
reason: China Daily 2021 islands feature: Wenling's southernmost inhabited island, tidal flats and camping; Trip adds black pebble beach, boat ~30 min. Sources: https://zhejiang.chinadaily.com.cn/etaizhou/2021-07/15/c_642977.htm

name: Shepan Island
reason: China Daily dedicated page and travelchinaguide: Taizhou's second-largest island, 'island of a thousand caves' (1,300 quarry caves), 20-min ferry from Liuao. Sources: https://regional.chinadaily.com.cn/ezhejiang/etaizhou/2018-12/26/c_310708.htm

name: Coral Rock and Taozhu Geopark
reason: travelchinaguide names Taozhu Provincial Scenic Area and Coral Rock; China Daily Taozhu page describes columnar volcanic rock, '13 islets' farmland and sea-eroded features in Linhai National Geopark. Sources: https://regional.chinadaily.com.cn/ezhejiang/etaizhou/2018-12/26/c_310712.htm

name: Ziyang Old Street
reason: China Daily dedicated page: 1,080 m best-preserved ancient street with old shops; Wikivoyage Fucheng entry mentions it; named a national tourism and leisure street. Sources: https://regional.chinadaily.com.cn/ezhejiang/etaizhou/2018-12/06/c_303681.htm

name: Jinshan Park
reason: Trip listings: Linhai hill park with the Three Towers (Wenfeng twin towers, Thousand Buddha Tower); no tourism-board source opened. Sources: Trip.com Jinshan Pagoda Group listing

name: Longxing Temple
reason: China Daily 'Some of most famous temples in Taizhou' names it: 1,300-year-old Linhai temple, birthplace of Japan's Tendai; Trip adds Thousand Buddha Tower. Sources: https://regional.chinadaily.com.cn/ezhejiang/etaizhou/2020-06/10/c_499284.htm

name: Wu Zixiong Glass Art Museum
reason: China Daily dedicated page and travelchinaguide ('Wu Zixiong Glass Art Exhibition Hall'): 10,000 sq m, about 10,000 glass artworks, one of Taizhou's top 10 attractions, 1-2 hr visit, entry about 30 yuan. Sources: https://regional.chinadaily.com.cn/ezhejiang/etaizhou/2018-12/06/c_303679.htm

name: Yuhuan Shaddock Orchard
reason: travelchinaguide lists a 'Shaddock Orchard' among other spots; no named place or visitor source found for it in English or Chinese; Yuhuan Wendan Festival is autumn only. Sources: travelchinaguide Taizhou
